description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Laguna Freak], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Career Change Mode II (Ice, Earth, Water) v2] to the user, grants [Water/Ice/Earth Ability Quick Cast 1] and [Dualcast Water/Ice/Earth 1]/[Water/Ice/Earth Ability Quick Cast 2] and [Dualcast Water/Ice/Earth 2]/[Water/Ice/Earth Ability Instant Cast 3] and [Dualcast Water/Ice/Earth 3] to the user if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF8 allies are alive

description.name: Awoken Laguna Freak
description.text: Water, Ice and Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water, Ice and Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Career Change Mode II (Ice, Earth, Water) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Ice/Earth/Water ability

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Water/Ice/Earth Ability Quick Cast 1
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Water, Ice and Earth abilities

description.name: Water/Ice/Earth Ability Quick Cast 2
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Water, Ice and Earth abilities

description.name: Water/Ice/Earth Ability Instant Cast 3
description.text: Instant cast speed for Water, Ice and Earth abilities
